description: `--notify` in a project with no package.json under Jest 30.5.2 (B23d A4): the haste map finds none, so the title starts with the root directory (`<root> - 100% Passed`). The fixture is not named after a package.json: Jest matches the pattern package.json against whole paths, so `package-json` in the directory name would count as one. The fake notifier appends each call's options (without the check mark Jest puts before the message on macOS only) to `notify.json`; the icon path is masked. One Jest worker. A black-box run.
